note: A small gravel parking lot on the south side of Second Narrows Road, about 1.8 miles in from Amberson Road: a teardrop-shaped pad roughly 30 m by 15 m with a grass margin, about 20 m off the road and below it. The booking page grades the driveway 'Severe' and elevation data agrees, with a drop of nearly 3 m between road and pad (about 13 percent), so expect a steep, short pull-in where a long rear overhang can drag; the pad itself has a slight slope. Pull-in only, with room to turn on the pad. Second Narrows Road is an unpaved forest road under trees. Picnic table and stone fire ring. No toilet; pack out trash. State forest roads get no winter maintenance and are not plowed. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: still listed and bookable online (every night open in the November 2026, May 2027 and July 2027 windows), Drive-In, Horse/Tent/Trailer categories, max vehicle length 25 ft, pull-in, gravel, driveway grade Severe. Booking, hookups, max length and year-round season confirmed; pull_through set false; toilets/water written as none; reservation fee added. Imagery: gravel pad with the pin on it (DCNR's GIS point is the same spot). 3DEP: about 2.7 m of fall over the 20 m from road to pad, pad slope about 4 percent. NHD: an intermittent stream 75 m away, nothing nearer.
